ITEM 1 | About 22 smooth, oval, tan-brown kernels with a pointed tip and slightly ridged surface, dry and matte, with some darker brown spots, scattered in a loose cluster on the left side of the plate, each about 2.5 cm long and 1.5 cm wide, covering roughly 9 by 12 cm | 30
ITEM 2 | Pale ivory-white branching florets with a bumpy, granular surface and firm, dense heads joined on short pale stems, dry-looking with no sauce or sheen, clustered in the upper right of the plate, covering roughly 8 by 6.5 cm and about 3 cm high | 50
ITEM 3 | Five small, glossy, smooth-skinned red oval fruits, each about 2.5 by 3.5 cm, with a slight sheen and no visible cuts or cooking marks, placed in a loose group to the right of the nuts and below the florets | 80
